not-content.rule: the name of a prop selects the member its value is written to
the name of a part selects where the part's content is written

the id of a family's overview part, rebuilt from the group id: <group id>_ovw

declared-drops.reason: path map: a withdrawn control is dropped as a tombstone; its lineage is inverted onto the successor its link names, which carries its URI, a label and its title
declared-drops.reading: not content, because the value `withdrawn` of a control that names a successor only decides where the control is written (as a lineage entry on its successor, under `replaces` and the annotation `nist-withdrawal`, which say the same by their names); it is a value and not a name, so none of the three classes names it
